method.source: Four prior equal-cadence development groups. Held tests use eight distinct older source groups with frozen multi-edit recipes, plus four disjoint authentic sources across two publishers with new edit recipes.
method.decision: Intersect the two checks. Median error tests for a run of mismatched retained pictures. The offset check measures whether any alternate forward offset produces a closer eight-picture correspondence.
method.primary_gate: Keep at least 90% of previously correct single-insertion reports in each held bank; withhold at least half the inaccurate multi/mixed reports overall. No new flagged controls or shifted boundaries. Report grade transfer separately.
